# Futu Opens Its Global Headquarter Office in Pacific Place, Growing Its Financial Services Ecosystem


Corporate News


--


(HONG KONG, September 21, 2026)


— Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (“Futu”)


announced the official opening of its new office at Pacific Place in Admiralty. To mark the occasion, Futu invited business leaders, private wealth clients, and partners to an inauguration ceremony, where they witnessed the start of Futu’s next chapter.


Spanning approximately 42,000 square feet, the new office doubles the size of its existing office at United Centre. Connected by a footbridge, Futu’s total office space now exceeds 70,000 square feet as the new office goes into service. Operating as an integrated hub, the two offices bring together the company's fintech, securities trading, wealth management, institutional services, Web3, and global operations capabilities, creating a comprehensive financial services ecosystem in the heart of Hong Kong's financial district and reinforcing the city's position as Futu's global business hub.


Positioned at the Heart of Hong Kong’s Financial District, Strengthening the City’s Status as a Global Financial Hub


As an international finance hub, Hong Kong serves as a strategic gateway connecting Futu to global markets and supporting its growth ambitions. Located at Pacific Place in the center of the city’s financial district, the new office places Futu alongside leading international financial institutions and multinational corporations. Beyond enhancing the company’s global visibility and brand presence, this move creates valuable opportunities to deepen collaboration with industry partners.


From left to right: Jeff Shi, Regional Director at Futu Securities; Arthur Chen, Chief Financial Officer at Futu Holdings; and Rainie Miao, Managing Partner and Head of Institutional and Privat eWealth Services at Futu Holdings


Dedicated Private Wealth Center Elevating Premium Client Services


The upgraded workspace and client facilities offer an optimized layout for various business teams, supporting Futu's continuous growth across brokerage, wealth management, private wealth, and institutional services. The new office houses an exclusive Private Wealth Center, providing high-net-worth and institutional clients with a private, elevated setting to access professional advisory services and tailored asset management solutions, leveraging Hong Kong's leading position as an international financial and fintech hub.


Futu Plans to Recruit 2,000 Professionals in Hong Kong Over the Next Five Years


As Futu expands its footprint and service offerings, it plans to recruit approximately 2,000 local and global talent in Hong Kong over the next five years. The hiring drive will focus on key areas including fintech, wealth management, compliance, and risk control, offering local financial talent a broad platform for international career development.


Futu’s expansion plans closely align with Hong Kong’s plans to attract high-caliber talent from around the world, most recently outlined in the latest Policy Address and the city’s inaugural Five-Year Plan. Moreover, Futu is backing Hong Kong’s push to drive innovation, recently donating HK$30 million to The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) to establish the "Futu Scholarship", nurturing local fintech talent while supporting cutting-edge scientific research.


Moving forward, Futu will continue to capitalize on Hong Kong's unique strengths, working alongside industry peers and the broader community to drive financial innovation and foster the long-term vitality of the financial ecosystem.


Arthur Chen, Chief Financial Officer at Futu Holdings


stated,


"Hong Kong has always been Futu's strategic core. Our new Pacific Place office represents far more than a physical expansion — it is a testament to our confidence in Hong Kong's future and our commitment to growing alongside the city. With its world-class financial ecosystem and outstanding talent pool, Hong Kong remains the ideal base to drive innovation, deepen industry collaboration, and connect investors with opportunities around the world. Since Futu was founded in 2012, our mission has been to transform the investment experience through technology. As we enter our next phase of growth, we will continue to increase our investment in Hong Kong, expand and diversify our business, cultivate future talent, and strengthen our position as a leading fintech company serving investors globally.”
